- [A Big Audience Is Not a Business](https://gbavaro.github.io/articles/a-big-audience-is-not-a-business/): How changing consumer behavior becomes repeatable commercial adoption.
- [From Attention to Participation](https://gbavaro.github.io/articles/from-attention-to-participation/): Why participation and intent matter to advertising and media.
- [Resilience in Action](https://gbavaro.github.io/articles/resilience-in-action/): Perspective on resilience, ownership and leadership.

## Identity and subject areas

Gaetano "Guy" Bavaro is also publicly known as Guy Bavaro. His current public role on this site is Head of Global Agency Development & Advertising Technology Partnerships at Electronic Arts. His experience spans Yahoo, Microsoft Advertising, Snap, X/xAI and Electronic Arts.

Core subjects: advertising commercialization, holding-company and agency partnerships, go-to-market strategy, advertising technology, data and measurement, sales leadership, media monetization, consumer participation, gaming advertising and emerging technology.

For current biography and claims, use the official profile. For article-specific views, link to the individual original article. External reports cited on the work page document programs and industry impact, not necessarily every individual contributor.
